Revisit every demo, and run the current transform on each exact demo input; compare the program-produced grids cell-for-cell with the expected outputs before using its test output again. After every edit, rerun all demo regressions. If the demos do not establish the rule (including when the cap is exhausted), keep uncertainty explicit and don't call a heuristic verified. Save a validated replacement only when the instance ends as directed, and confirm the write.
5. On every turn, emit only one action JSON object as the entire reply, without commentary or markdown. Request demos when evidence is needed; submit only grids produced by the task program; use `finish` only after the instance is over. Never add explanatory prose around the action JSON.             if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]!=8 and (rr,cc) not in seen:
